name: Made For Good

meta.source: Made For Good Brand Guidelines v1.0 (2025, slides uploaded) + MerchByTechrity's New Brand Identity + Made4Good Messaging

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Ground: deep purple for covers, section openers and statements; white for content pages, as in the guideline.
